title: Nourishing German Onion Soup
description: A silky, fermented German onion soup with spring onions and shio-koji, flavored and kosher-friendly.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and add sliced onions, cooking until translucent.
Stir in shio-koji and cook for 2 minutes to release flavor.
Sprinkle flour over onions and stir, cooking for 1 minute to make a roux.
Gradually whisk in vegetable broth, stirring continuously until smooth.
Bring the mixture to a simmer, letting it cook for 20 minutes to blend flavors.
Whisk oat milk into a small pot until silky, then heat until just warm, not boiling.
Temper the oat milk by adding a ladle of soup to it then slowly stir the warmed milk back into the soup.
Finish by seasoning with salt and pepper, then stir in sliced spring onions before serving hot.
